display.purpose: Hero H1 only. Condensed uppercase, one per page.
display.lineHeightNote: Pinned in W1-T06 via the Cyrillic Clearance Rule: 0.94 clips ЙЇЁ diacritics in Oswald 700 at display size; 0.98 clears them. Same value across all locales. Never overflow:hidden on display headings. W2 addendum: display copy avoids stacking Щ/Ц/Д directly above Й/Ї across a line break; RU/UA display line breaks are controlled manually.

card-title.purpose: Card and tile H3. Condensed uppercase 600.

body.purpose: Standard reading copy. Sentence case, system-ui.

mono-label.purpose: Eyebrow/kicker with red rule-line. JetBrains Mono caps.

mono-micro.purpose: Chips, captions, stat labels. JetBrains Mono caps.

mono-data.purpose: USDOT/MC/$ figures, tabular numerics. Normal case.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Paper card resting shadow (carried from V1).

shadows.name: red-glow
shadows.purpose: CTA gradient resting shadow. The only colored shadow. One per viewport.

shadows.name: board-depth

motion.name: reveal-rule
motion.purpose: Entrances must take the instant path in prerender snapshots and under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: CTA Gradient Button
components.description: Primary conversion CTA. The only legal gradient in the system. White text passes AA at both stops. Resting red-glow shadow; one per viewport (Signal Budget).
components.css: .v2-btn-cta { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:14px 20px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d70f24,#a90918); color:#fff; border:0; border-radius:6px; font-family:var(--v2-font-display); font-size:15px; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(215,15,36,.22); cursor:pointer; min-height:44px; } .v2-btn-cta:hover { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c40d1f,#8f0714); } .v2-btn-cta:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.name: Ghost Button (on dark)
components.description: Secondary action on board surfaces. Pill, hairline border, headlight-white text.
components.css: .v2-btn-ghost-dark { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:12px 18px; background:transparent; color:#fff7ed; border:1px solid rgba(255,247,237,.24); border-radius:999px; font-family:var(--v2-font-display); font-size:14px; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; min-height:44px; } .v2-btn-ghost-dark:hover { border-color:rgba(255,247,237,.5); }

components.name: Board Section Shell
components.description: Full-width dark section band. Hairline top border, optional 18%-alpha red radial glow (hero only).
components.css: .v2-board { background:#050607; color:#fff7ed; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,247,237,.14); } .v2-section-inner { max-width:1440px; margin:0 auto; padding:clamp(56px,8vh,96px) 34px; }

components.name: Manifest Section Shell
components.description: Full-width paper section band for working content.

components.name: Section Head
components.description: Mono eyebrow with 46x2 red rule-line above condensed H2. Density cap: max 2 consecutive sections open with this pair.
components.html:
WHO WE SERVE

Built for buyers who move inventory
components.css: .v2-eyebrow { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#9c9b96; } .v2-eyebrow::before { content:''; width:46px; height:2px; background:#d70f24; } .v2-h2 { font-family:var(--v2-font-display); font-size:clamp(1.9rem,3.4vw,3.25rem); line-height:.98; letter-spacing:.035em; text-transform:uppercase; margin:12px 0 0; }

components.name: Board Card
components.description: Card on dark surfaces. Panel steel or translucent wash, hairline border, inset top-light. Hover: border brightens, lift <=3px.
components.css: .v2-card-board { background:rgba(255,255,255,.045); border:1px solid rgba(255,247,237,.14); border-radius:18px; padding:28px; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.07); transition:transform 250ms ease-out,border-color 250ms ease-out; } .v2-card-board:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); border-color:rgba(255,247,237,.24); }

components.name: Paper Card
components.description: Card on manifest surfaces. Card cream, hairline border, V1 shadow scale carried.
components.css: .v2-card-paper { background:#fffaf1; border:1px solid rgba(5,6,7,.14); border-radius:18px; padding:28px; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.04),0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06); } .v2-card-paper:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.04),0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.08); }

components.name: Trust Stat Tile
components.description: Hairline-divided stat grid on 4.5% wash. Red stat numbers are large-text only (contrast law); labels mono-micro.
components.css: .v2-trust-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:1px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.12); border:1px solid rgba(255,247,237,.14); border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden; } .v2-trust-row > div { background:rgba(255,255,255,.045); padding:18px 16px; } .v2-trust-row b { display:block; font-family:var(--v2-font-display); font-size:24px; color:#d70f24; letter-spacing:.04em; } .v2-trust-row span { font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#e8e0d3; }

components.name: Kaizen Stamp
components.description: Red-bordered 改善 stamp. Brand mark: aria-hidden, never translated, density cap 2 JP accents per viewport.
components.css: .v2-stamp { display:inline-block; border:1px solid rgba(215,15,36,.75); color:#d70f24; border-radius:4px; padding:5px 3px; font-family:var(--v2-font-jp,serif); font-size:15px; line-height:1; text-align:center; }

components.name: JP Vertical Strip
components.description: Vertical brand strip (fixed inventory). writing-mode vertical-rl, muted 58% alpha, aria-hidden.
components.html: シンプル・迅速・信頼
components.css: .v2-jp-vertical { writing-mode:vertical-rl; text-orientation:upright; font-family:var(--v2-font-jp,serif); letter-spacing:.18em; color:rgba(255,247,237,.58); font-size:16px; line-height:1.7; }

narrative.overview: Two surfaces carry the system: the dark board (near-black #050607) for conviction moments and the paper manifest (#f4f0e8) for working documents. Signal red #d70f24 is a budgeted signal, never atmosphere. Condensed uppercase display + JetBrains Mono microcopy + a fixed inventory of Japanese serif brand marks tie the site to the vehicle-wrap brand system V4. B2B-first; supersedes the Trade Bulletin (V1). Honesty doctrine carried: no urgency theater, hedged promises, milestone status language, locale parity across EN/RU/UA/PL.
keyCharacteristics: Board/manifest surface alternation; conversion pages open and close dark
Signal Budget: one red fill + two red accents per viewport, red <=8% of pixels
Condensed uppercase display with mandatory Cyrillic coverage; body stays sentence-case system-ui
JetBrains Mono as the operational microcopy voice
JP accents are aria-hidden brand marks from a fixed inventory (max 2/viewport, 3/page)
Only legal gradient: CTA pair #d70f24 to #a90918
Reveal/__Y7_PRERENDER gates mandatory for all entrances
rules: The Kicker-Headline Pair V2 + density cap
dos: Open conversion pages dark, close dark, alternate between
Render credentials, IDs, prices, stat labels in JetBrains Mono
Budget red: one fill + two accents per viewport
Ship display-font Cyrillic coverage; identical treatment across locales
Import src/styles/v2/ primitives; never re-implement inline
donts: No red section backgrounds or washes; no second gradient
No translated or meaningful JP accents
No adjacent same-surface sections on conversion pages
No highway stock photos, chrome, italic speed cliches
No text shadows (single hero-URL exception), no glassmorphism
No V1 artifacts in V2 surfaces (diamond glyph, pine kickers, sienna)
